name: meho-claude-desktop
description: Connect Claude Desktop to an internal MEHO backplane via the mcp-remote shim (VPN required).

backplane_url.title: MEHO MCP endpoint
backplane_url.description: Your backplane's MCP URL, e.g. https://meho.internal.example/mcp — must be reachable over your VPN.

ca_cert.title: Internal CA bundle (optional)
ca_cert.description: PEM bundle for the internal CA that signs the backplane's TLS certificate. Leave empty for public-CA deploys.

client_id.title: OAuth client id (advanced)
client_id.description: Pre-registered public OAuth client the shim presents to Keycloak. Leave as the default unless your realm registered the client under a different name.
